item.title: Billie Eilish Says She Started Watching Porn at 11: ‘It Really Destroyed My Brain’
item.description: Billie Eilish revealed in an interview this week that she started watching pornography at a young age, something she feels “incredibly devastated” about.

item.title: Couple Hides $1K Cash Inside Baby Products at Target to Help New Parents and Spread Kindness
item.description: A California couple who “struggled to make ends meet” after welcoming their first child is looking to help lift the financial burden and spread kindness among new parents in a sweet and surprising way.

item.title: Dear Teenage Son: Be Patient With Me As I Let Go
item.description: Be patient as I learn to let go. I love you more than you'll ever know. And darling, I am still dreaming of your tomorrows.

item.title: To the Stay at Home Mom Who Is Wasting Her Life
item.description: Ever since I was 10 years old, I wanted to go to law school, but I never have. Some would call my choice to be a stay at home mom a waste.

item.title: 8 Things Boy Moms Should Know About Their Sons
item.description: Boy moms have a huge challenge in raising good men. Here are a few things to make it just a little easier.

item.title: The Bedtime Hoops: 4 Important Questions to Ask Kids at Bedtime
item.description: These four questions to ask kids at bedtime have changed our relationship. They've brought us closer and created a more positive shift in their focus throughout their day and in mine.

item.title: 15 Ways to Break Your Child’s Heart (Without Realizing It)
item.description: No one wants to break their child's heart at all, much less through discipline and correction—but here are 15 ways that many well-meaning parents do just that.

item.title: Here’s Why We Can’t Parent the Way Our Parents Did
item.description: The problem isn’t that younger parents don't want our children to have childhoods like we did; it’s that in many ways, we can't let them have those childhoods.

item.title: In Case You Didn’t Know, I Unfriended You. Here’s Why.
item.description: Did you notice that I unfriended you on Facebook? Here's why an unfollow just wouldn't do.
